title: 第20章 十二连板，910万
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“炒啊。”

    李西雄道：“我跟西海，西朋都在炒，进的还是一支股票。”

    宋锦问道：“听你们说五连板，那肯定是大赚了啊。”

    “怪不得哥会这么高兴。”

    李西雄很是唏嘘的感慨道：“是赚了。”

    “但之前亏的老惨了。”

    “不是西海说他要进去试试，我也没坚持下来。”

    他当时确实有点病急乱投医，也是没底气自信。

    所以就想着从别人口中找点理由说服自己。

    要是当天李西海没说要入手试试，他真可能会割肉离场，错失这波回本大赚的行情。

    “你赚了几十万，本钱肯定不少。”

    宋锦咬着筷子的一头，看向李西海，道：“西海哥，你投了多少。”

    “对啊。”

    李西朋连忙将东西咽下去，急道：“我之前就想问的，我投了十万。”

    “西海哥之前就炒股，听说是赚了不少。”

    “这次西海哥投了多少进去？”

    李西雄也挺好奇的，问道：“西海，你投了多少个？”

    李西海慢悠悠的吃着东西，没有急着回答，慢条斯理的咽下去后，看了一眼宋锦的漂亮脸蛋，还有那求知的目光。

    “想知道？”

    三人都点头。

    李西朋道：“五连板啊，雄哥回本赚了几十万，我都赚了五六万。”

    “你肯定不会少赚。”

    李西海道：“求我！”

    话音落下，宋锦就接话，道：“西海哥，求求你告诉我吧。”

    “求你啦。”

    那娇弱软绵的哀求语气，配上那撒娇的神态。

    别说李西朋跟李西雄来了战术后仰。

    就是李西海也是扛不住。

    不愧是我一眼就看出来是绿茶女的潜质啊。

    就这哄人的手段，就这在兄弟面前给他提供的面子价值。

    不得不说，真是个妖精。

    “290个。”

    李西海淡淡的说道。

    “29……。”

    李西朋念了一声，突然觉得不对，“什么？”

    “290个？”

    “290W？”李西雄追问。

    宋锦的美眸也放大了。

    李西海点头。

    李西朋立马起身，从电脑桌上，把手机给拿过来。
content_en:
"Fried."

    Li Xixiong said: "Xi Hai, west Peng, I are all speculating, and all we got was a stock."

    Song Jin asked: "I heard from you that Wulianban must be a big profit."

    "No wonder brother is so happy."

    Li Xixiong sighed with regret: "It's a profit."

    "But I suffered a lot of losses before."

    "It wasn't Xihai who said he wanted to go in and give it a try, and I didn't insist on it either."

    He was indeed a little sick at the time and sought medical treatment urgently, but he also lacked the confidence and self-confidence.

    So I tried to find some reasons from others to convince myself.

    If Li Xihai hadn't said that he wanted to try it out that day, he might have left the market and missed out on this wave of profit-making.

    "You have made hundreds of thousands, so you must have a lot of capital."

    Song Jin bit one end of his chopsticks, looked at Li Xihai, and said, "Brother Xihai, how many did you throw in?"

    "Yes."

    Li Xipeng quickly swallowed the thing and said hurriedly: "I wanted to ask you before. I invested 100,000."

    "Brother Xihai has been speculating in stocks before, and I heard he made a lot of money."

    "How much did Brother Xihai put in this time?"

    Li Xixiong was also curious and asked: "Xihai, how many did you vote for?"

    Li Xihai ate slowly and did not answer in a hurry. After swallowing it slowly, he took a look at Song Jin's beautiful face and his eyes that were seeking knowledge.

    "Want to know?"

    All three nodded.

    Li Xipeng said: "Wu Lian Ban, brother Xiong made hundreds of thousands of dollars back, and I made fifty or sixty thousand."

    "You will definitely make less money."

    Li Xihai said: "Please!"

    After the words fell, Song Jin answered and said: "Brother Xihai, please tell me."

    "Please."

    That delicate and soft pleading tone was matched with that coquettish look.

    Not to mention that Li Xipeng and Li Xixiong came to the tactical retreat.

    Even Li Xihai couldn't bear it.

    As expected, I could see her potential as a green tea girl right away.

    Just this way of coaxing people, just this face value provided to him in front of his brothers.

    I have to say, what a monster.

    "290."

    Li Xihai said lightly.

    “29….”

    Li Xipeng read aloud and suddenly felt something was wrong, "What?"

    "290?"

    "290W?" Li Xixiong asked.

    Song Jin's beautiful eyes also widened.

    Li Xihai nodded.

    Li Xipeng stood up immediately and took his cell phone from the computer table.
